title: The verdict schema + the voice contract (blueprint Mile 3)
status_note: Describes what happened (Law 3). All six oracle lines met; two of them only AFTER repair, and the repairs came from checks this leg ran against itself. The measured before/after REFUTES the brief's own cost premise, which is a finding rather than a failure - the brief invited measurement and got it. Nothing is wired into the panel: T.4's freeze holds until V3 lands, so this leg proves the shape, not the flow.
settings_profile: relay-settings.json (declared in harness/legs.json). Executed directly in the orchestrator session rather than dispatched to a fenced subagent, so tool access was the session's, not the profile's. pytest WAS available and run - suite evidence is legitimate under Article V. The adversarial pass ran as `crucible` subagents (Read/Grep/Glob/Bash only, no Edit/Write), which is a real fence, not a prompt instruction.

D1 - two report figures had no producer; v2_report_verify.py + v2_voice_probe.py
the adversarial pass's blocker and six other repairs, each pinned by a new mutation

touches_note: The three declared files are exactly the product code changed. The extension is tests + producers + artifacts, all V2-namespaced. NOT declared in legs.json, and named here rather than left to be noticed - see V2-R6.

test_delta: +161 passed, 0 failed. Every added test is V2's; no existing test was weakened, skipped, xfailed or deleted.
commandment_7: HELD - strictly increases. Three of this leg's OWN tests went red mid-run when the wire schema dropped `by`; per Law 6 they were REWRITTEN to assert the behaviour at its real home (the constructor still refuses an anonymous verdict; the wire form's job is never to ask), not deleted.
suite_evidence_claim: system python 3.14.2 gate runner, `python -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider`. The vendored tree is INACTIVE on this interpreter. This is NOT the shipping hython figure and does not claim to be.

oracle.typed_contract_by_non_nullable_ENFORCED: MET. `by` is the first field with no default, so Verdict() is a TypeError from the language. by=None raises; a dict raises. Survived every construction-path attack the adversarial pass tried (dataclasses.replace, copy.replace, subclassing). Mutations `none_by` and `anonymous_by` both caught.
oracle.voice_contract_as_a_validator_demonstrat: MET, with a measured hole. 10/10 rules fire on their own violation and stay silent on a conforming one; test_every_rule_is_demonstrated_firing asserts the firing-case set EQUALS the rule set, so a rule cannot ship undemonstrated. On an 18-verdict labelled corpus the rules score 0% false positives and 100% false negatives - see V2-F9.
oracle.templated_fallback_after_three_rejection: MET after repair. Fires on the 3rd submission and not the 2nd; a model that recovers on the 3rd keeps its words AND the gate now records that it did (V2-F10 was that it did not); the template degrades rather than smuggling a rejected hedge; returns empty when nothing structured exists.
oracle.invariant_8_suite_two_or_more_tiers_byte: MET after repair. 3 tiers, asserted on utf-8 bytes not string equality, in three arms (renderer tier-invariance / register convergence under the gate / fallback purity), plus an anti-vacuity control (the masked row is masking something real), a demonstrated red (a tier-branching renderer), and a mask-footprint control added after V2-F17.
oracle.measured_before_after_via_count_tokens: MET, and it REFUTES the brief's premise. Calibration PASS against R155's committed 2,961 before any new figure was published. 13 free calls, no completions.
oracle.nothing_rendered_in_the_panel: HELD. grep confirms zero importers of verdict.py or voice_contract.py under python/synapse/panel/. No call site in synapse_panel.py or face_review.py was touched.

calibration.CAL_3: PASS - the loaded tone guide is the committed TONE.md, not a stale cache

calibration.CAL_5: PASS x10 - no voice rule fires on a conforming verdict
calibration.CAL_6: PASS - the firing-case set equals the rule set
calibration.CAL_7: PASS - invariant 8's masked row is masking something real (3 distinct BY values)
calibration.CAL_8: PASS - invariant 8 detects a renderer that branches on tier

calibration.R133_controls_mutation_tested: 29 of 29 mutations caught. The FIRST run found 10 survivors - see V2-F1, the leg's most useful hour.
calibration.law_1_note: Two of this leg's own controls could not fail for the defect they named (V2-F17) and one invariant-8 arm was blind by fixture (V2-F10). Both were found by instruments this leg built or commissioned, not by luck, and both are now pinned.

findings.claim: All ten voice rules were unpinnable: validate() took rules=VOICE_RULES as a DEFAULT ARGUMENT, snapshotting the table at import, so nothing a mutation changed was ever read. Two authorities on one table - the shape panel/tokens.py was repaired for.
findings.so_what: The first mutation run reported 10 survivors. Fixed in the product (call-time resolution), not in the harness. This is R127's defect wearing ten masks, exactly the standard R131 set.

findings.claim: There is no ratified model-tier vocabulary. RoutingTier (cache/recipe/instant/fast/standard/deep) is the CASCADE tier, a different axis. by.tier is shape-checked (lowercase identifier), not vocabulary-checked; By.validate_tier(vocabulary) is the opt-in hook.
findings.so_what: V3 owns the manifest and runs concurrently. A closed set invented here would reject V3's names on the day it lands.

findings.claim: The schema's two-state checks cannot express 'inconclusive'. face_review renders five statuses and RETINA's receipt is tri-state with a RATIFIED rule that an inconclusive check must not render as a pass.
findings.so_what: check_from_tristate maps None -> fail: lossy in the safe direction, and named rather than hidden. Widening the schema is not this leg's call.

findings.claim: `cost` is carried by the contract and not rendered. The panel's rule is TOKENS ONLY, never $, and no usage reader is closed (E0-F12), so a cost row today would be a currency figure with no producer.
findings.so_what: The field stays on the object so the schema is not silently narrowed; whether it should ever draw is a ruling.

findings.claim: The typed schema has no slot for decision_log's `classified` flag, which rule 3 of that module deliberately keeps loud for an unregistered tool.
findings.so_what: The adapter REFUSES to convert an unclassified row unless the caller opts in, rather than converting and forgetting - which would make the surface quietest exactly where P1 made it loudest.

findings.claim: Invariant 1 as written ('the panel renders NO string the model wrote, except verdict') is contradicted by work merged the same morning: decision_log QUOTES a model sentence and renders it.
findings.so_what: The provenance ladder makes the distinction enforceable and checkable, but whether MODEL_QUOTED SATISFIES invariant 1 or VIOLATES it is a value judgement between defensible options.

findings.claim: The brief's premise - 'it shrinks the thing that cannot be cached' - is REFUTED on preload tokens. 688 out, 1,046 in (928 lean): a net cost of 240-358. Price moves the other way (~755 BTE/call, VERIFIED-DERIVED) because the tokens moved from a span rewritten every turn into the cached tool prefix.
findings.so_what: E0's central correction applied to the leg that cited E0: preload tokens and price are different quantities. The voice case for this leg stands on its own and never needed the cache argument.

findings.claim: synapse_economist_blueprint.md is not in the tree. The brief cites sections 3.1/3.2/04/P7 and invariants 1/6/8; SYNAPSE_ECONOMIST.md section 3 restates six invariants under DIFFERENT numbering (blueprint 6 = harness 4, blueprint 8 = harness 6, blueprint 1 absent entirely).
findings.so_what: Drift, not a blocker - the load-bearing content was inlined in the brief. But no leg after this one should cite a blueprint section number as if it could be looked up.

findings.claim: The ten rules are LEXICAL. On a labelled corpus: 8 of 8 good verdicts accepted (0% false positives), 0 of 10 adversarial verdicts caught (100% false negatives). 'Everything went fine with Dark_Glass' and the bare token 'Dark_Glass' both pass.
findings.so_what: Zero false positives is the result that matters most - the rules never burn a re-ask on a verdict that was already right. But the brief's 'a weak model must not be able to produce a weak panel' holds for the STRUCTURE and for prose that trips a lexical rule, NOT yet for a sentence that is merely empty. Deliberately not closed: rules tuned against ten verdicts by one author would be over-fitted and then cited as coverage. The corpus is committed as a regression target.

findings.claim: BLOCKER. submit() returned an ACCEPTED outcome without setting _final, so resolve() fell through to the object's ORIGINAL free field - the canonical reject/rewrite/accept loop rendered the string the gate had just REJECTED, violations intact. The invariant-8 arm that should have caught it was blind BY FIXTURE (it submitted the sentence the fixture already carried, so both sides were equal by construction).
findings.so_what: Found by the adversarial pass, reproduced by four independent verifiers. submit() now latches acceptance; resolve() raises rather than answering before anything is settled; `settled` and `exhausted` are now separate questions. Pinned by the `unlatched_accept` mutation and a fixture that carries prose the gate must reject.

findings.claim: The lookbehind excluded '/', so a name written inside its own path (dome_light in /lights/dome_light) did not match - the rule refusing the most specific form of exactly what it asks for.
findings.so_what: Fixed; pinned by `path_name_refused` plus a companion test that dome_lighting still does not count as dome_light.

findings.claim: _trim appended its ellipsis AFTER cutting to the limit, returning limit+1 chars for any string with no space in its first `limit` characters - i.e. every node path, which is exactly what _CHOICE_KEYS selects. The typed field then raised and to_verdict_decisions took the WHOLE cycle down with it.
findings.so_what: A function taking a limit and returning limit+1 is a bug on its own; it became a crash at the seam this leg exists to close. Fixed, and a rejected row is now dropped and COUNTED (rejected_conversions) rather than costing every other decision in the cycle.

findings.claim: The wire form REQUIRED the model to author its own credit line: its own model id, tier, 96 characters of free-text `reason`, and its own token counts - all of which render - while the tool description said 'you write only verdict'. A second free field arriving through the one door invariant 1 exists to watch.
findings.so_what: `by` is SYSTEM data: the panel knows which provider it called. Removed from the emit schema, which ALSO cut 138 tokens. Pinned by `author_on_the_wire` and a per-field test so no single By field creeps back.

findings.claim: The schema blessed payloads the constructor rejects - `paths` was an unconstrained string array while Verdict enforced absolute-and-96. 17 of 17 adversarial payloads validated against the schema and raised at construction.
findings.so_what: That gap is where an agent emits something valid and the panel explodes on it. Constrained; pinned by `unconstrained_wire_paths`.

findings.claim: tokens_in=1.9 constructed and rendered through %d as '1' - a wrong figure becoming a plausible one on the way to the screen.
findings.so_what: Token fields now refuse floats; cost stays fractional because money is. Pinned by `fractional_tokens`.

findings.claim: break_even_calls floor-divided the one-time write by the per-call saving and added 1 - neither the closed form nor a ceiling, right for these inputs by coincidence, and it would have reported a break-even for a regime that never breaks even.
findings.so_what: Replaced with the closed form solved for the smallest whole n, returning None when the per-call saving is non-positive.

findings.claim: Two of this leg's own controls could not fail for the defect they named. register_signature could be replaced with one masking EVERY value - collapsing invariant 8 to 'the row keys match' - and the suite stayed green, because one control read the unmasked render_rows and the other re-implemented the masking locally. And the schema-ceiling test compared two reads of the same variable, so a hardcoded literal left it green.
findings.so_what: Both rewritten to call the PRODUCT function and to MOVE the constant. Pinned by `over_masked_signature`. This is the D1 grounded-coverage shape appearing inside the instrument the oracle rests on.

drift.what: Two figures in the first committed draft of V2_VERDICT.md had no producer: a /stage->/out swing published as 1,712 where the artifact says 1,567, and a schema-to-tone ratio of 1.6x where it was 1.72x at the time. Both written from recall of E0's proxy figures rather than read off V2_prompt_delta.json.
drift.why_it_matters: Law 5 inside the document that cites Law 2, and R127's exact shape - a number whose producer I wrote and did not read back. Caught by cross-checking every figure against its artifact before the receipt.
drift.remedy: Corrected at 4da7d92, recorded in the report's Drift section rather than silently, and made structural: v2_report_verify.py declares 26 load-bearing figures with the JSON path that emits each, compares them, and sweeps the measurement section for any number nothing accounts for. Its sweep is itself demonstrated failing.

drift.what: The governing blueprint synapse_economist_blueprint.md does not exist in the tree; harness/SYNAPSE_ECONOMIST.md restates a renumbered subset of its invariants.
drift.why_it_matters: Structural per Article VI, but non-blocking: the brief inlined every load-bearing clause, so nothing was decided from a document that could not be read.
drift.remedy: Recorded as V2-F8 and escalated. No section number from that blueprint is cited as verifiable anywhere in this leg's output.

drift.what: The adversarial workflow spawned 42 agents against a session guideline of ~15.
drift.why_it_matters: Six lenses fanning out to six verifiers each is 42 by construction and I did not cap it. It found the leg's blocker, so the spend bought something - but the shape was not chosen deliberately.
drift.remedy: Named here so the next leg caps the verifier fan-out explicitly rather than discovering the multiplication afterwards.

limits: NOTHING IS WIRED. No panel call site imports either module. The contract is enforced on construction and nothing in the product constructs one yet - this leg proves the shape, V3 plus the panel unfreeze prove the flow.

NO MODEL IN THE LOOP. The voice rules were demonstrated against hand-written tier-characteristic prose. TIER_PROSE in the invariant-8 suite and both corpora in v2_voice_probe.py are FIXTURES, NOT SAMPLES, written by one author - which is exactly why V2-F9 is reported rather than patched.
The false-negative rate is 100% on the measured corpus (V2-F9). Empty-but-grammatical register passes.

The price figure is VERIFIED-DERIVED on three inputs neither this leg nor E0 verified: E0's 1.25x/0.1x multipliers (E0 limit A1), the absence of a closed usage reader (E0-F12), and the perpetual-write assumption. The third was challenged in review and HELD on E0's own artifact (E0_segments.json stationary.system_whole.stable_across_3_turns = false).
no_request_echo's 0.6 ratio has no producer. It is a chosen threshold, not a measured one - the only rule constant not calibrated against data.
The counterfactual measures removing TONE.md ENTIRELY. If any part of the tone guide governs behaviour the schema does not cover, the real available saving is smaller than 688.
Suite evidence is the system python 3.14.2 gate, not the shipping hython runner; the vendored tree is INACTIVE on this interpreter.
The mutation harness pins the guards it names, not the whole suite. A mutation set is a lower bound on coverage, never a proof of it.

for_ruling.item: Does MODEL_QUOTED provenance SATISFY invariant 1, or violate it? decision_log quotes a model sentence and renders it; the blueprint says the panel renders no string the model wrote except `verdict`. The ladder makes the distinction enforceable either way - the question is which way it should be enforced.
for_ruling.why_escalated: Article I - a value judgement between two defensible readings of a ratified invariant, and P1 (merged) sits on one side of it.

for_ruling.item: Ratify the model-tier vocabulary once V3's manifest lands, then pass it to By.validate_tier. Until then by.tier is shape-checked only.
for_ruling.why_escalated: Inventing tier names here would bind V3's naming from a leg that cannot see V3's probe results.

for_ruling.item: The schema's `checks` is two-state and cannot express RETINA's ratified 'inconclusive'. Widen the schema to three states, or accept check_from_tristate's lossy None->fail mapping permanently?
for_ruling.why_escalated: Widening a blueprint schema is not a leg's call, and the safe mapping loses information that a ratified honesty rule cares about.

for_ruling.item: Should `cost` ever render? It is carried by the schema and deliberately not drawn, because the panel rule is TOKENS ONLY, never $, and no usage reader is closed.
for_ruling.why_escalated: A product-surface decision that trades a schema field against a ratified display rule.

for_ruling.item: V2-F9: the voice rules catch 0 of 10 adversarial verdicts. Close the gap with additional rules (and if so, calibrated against what corpus?), accept the lexical floor, or gate on real model output first? v2_voice_probe.py's corpus is the regression target either way.
for_ruling.why_escalated: Adding rules tuned against ten self-written verdicts would be over-fitting that then gets cited as coverage. Choosing the calibration source is a judgement, and it decides whether 'a weak model cannot produce a weak panel' is true or aspirational.

for_ruling.item: legs.json declares V2's touches as three panel files; the leg also wrote 3 test files and 12 harness/notes/econ artifacts. Should `touches` name only product code (current practice, and E0/E1 did the same), or every path a leg writes?
for_ruling.why_escalated: R92 makes touches the collision-avoidance instrument. If it means product-only, the manifest cannot detect a producer-file collision between two legs; if it means everything, every leg's entry has to be written after the work.

for_ruling.item: The terminal fallback returns "" when there is no decision to template from, leaving the verdict row empty. Confirm empty-and-honest over a composed generic ('Work complete.').
for_ruling.why_escalated: A defensible-options judgement. Implemented the honest way, consistent with decision_log.why_from_reasoning, but it is a product-voice call.

resume_token.next: V3 (probe layer) is independent and disjoint. The panel wiring is BLOCKED until V3 lands - T.4's freeze. Before wiring, settle V2-R1 (what invariant 1 means for quoted prose) and V2-R5 (whether the lexical floor is the floor), because both change what the panel is allowed to draw.

ratification_note: ratified:false is the correct resting state (Constitution Article I). Nothing here flips a gate, and Gate C is human-only.
